prompt_policy: Pure scientific-educational portrait infographic; concept visual-first with minimal exact labels; full image explains the mechanism or comparison in no more than six clusters; mobile/tablet/laptop readable; facts restricted to l8_visual_blueprint.json and l8_ab_rewrite.json; no UI, slogan, logo, watermark, decorative copy or invented claim.

pairs.prompt_focus: Neutral-symbol IUCN ladder, threatened bracket, CR/EW/EX and DD/NE distinctions
pairs.review: pass; identifiable species removed so placement cannot imply a real taxon's status

pairs.prompt_focus: Five IUCN diagnostic lenses, thresholds, time window and Criterion D/E logic
pairs.review: pass; Criterion E replacement has labelled axes and an unambiguously rising extinction-probability curve

pairs.prompt_focus: Project versus Recovery Programme versus Action Plan
pairs.review: pass; administrative distinctions are clear and unsupported milestones removed

pairs.prompt_focus: Project Tiger, NTCA, AITE evidence and source-separated tiger figures
pairs.review: pass; figures retain source labels and M-STrIPES remains distinct

pairs.prompt_focus: Four tiger roles and dispersal versus carrying-capacity inference
pairs.review: pass; normal dispersal factors and caution are visually explicit

pairs.prompt_focus: Project Elephant objectives, DNA estimate, comparability, corridors and conflict
pairs.review: pass; dated estimate/range and method break remain readable

pairs.prompt_focus: Greater Gir inside/outside boundary, dated growth and concentration risk
pairs.review: pass; rejected speculative map replaced by landscape-based explanation

pairs.prompt_focus: Cheetah reintroduction, source countries, two sites and moving dated totals
pairs.review: pass; false last-animal wording and fake 000 counter removed

pairs.prompt_focus: SPAI estimate, camera traps, scat genetics, programmes and threats
pairs.review: pass; figures, dates and four threats are legible and source-aligned

pairs.prompt_focus: Project Dolphin scope versus the 6,327 river-assessment scope
pairs.review: pass after independent-QA replacement; Indus, Ganga and Brahmaputra are three separate survey bands, 6,327 appears once as their combined surveyed-system total, river panels use long-beaked low-ridge river-dolphin morphology, and the sea-scope panel alone uses a distinct curved-fin marine dolphin

pairs.prompt_focus: Gharial ecology, head-starting, three crocodilian statuses and uneven recovery
pairs.review: pass; process and outcome distinction are visually clear

pairs.prompt_focus: Vulture diclofenac collapse, bustard power-line threat and release terminology
pairs.review: pass; dated totals/plans and destination-status decision path are explicit

rejections.reason: Recognisable animals were visually assigned to incorrect or unsupported IUCN categories; replacements use neutral symbols/population dots.
One added unsupported detail; another showed a falling Criterion E curve. Final graph rises and has correctly labelled axes.
Invented future milestones and inspirational copy.
Decorative conservation slogans not present in source.
Speculative map detail and decorative slogans.
Fake 000 population counter and false claim that the last cheetahs were killed in 1952.
Repeated 6,327 beside each river, falsely implying an individual total for each system.
Merged the Indus, Ganga and Brahmaputra into one literal confluence and therefore created a geographically misleading visual.
Separated the basins but added unsupported slogans and gave river dolphins an overly prominent dorsal fin.
Added unnecessary species examples, map detail and footer slogans beyond the approved facts.
